Source.Name: perl-image-sane
Source.Summary: Perl extension for the SANE Project
Source.Description: This module allows you to access SANE-compatible scanners in a Perlish and object-oriented way, freeing you from the casting and memory management in C, yet remaining very close in spirit to original API.
